messages:
drift-bot: [ALERT] config-drift detected between staging and prod for namespace=infra-inference, resource=daemonset/gpu-sidecar. Link: https://git.redwood.internal/diffs/infra-inference/gpu-sidecar

maria: seeing the alert. staging autoscaler started scaling nodes down earlier; curious why sidecar image tag differs across overlays.

jonas: which fields are different? can you paste the kustomize diff or helm values?

maria: quick snippet from `gitops-diff` (staging vs prod):
```
- image: redwood/gpu-sidecar:v1.4.0
+ image: redwood/gpu-sidecar:v1.5.0
  nodeSelector:
-   accelerator: nvidia-tesla-v100
+   accelerator: nvidia-tesla-a100
```

ashley: i pushed the staging overlay patch yesterday to bump the healthcheck and image tag — i must've only updated the staging kustomize overlay. my bad.

devops: ok two things: 1) we should bisection the overlay commits to confirm when the nodeSelector change landed, 2) avoid auto-reconcile to prod until we verify GPU SKU compatibility.

jonas: bisection command to try: `git bisect start -- staging..prod && git bisect run ./scripts/kustomize-validate.sh` — the script checks nodeSelector + image tag.

maria: ran the bisect locally, culprit commit is infra/overlays/staging@c6a9f2 (the overlay bump). It WAS intended for staging only.

devops: we should add a CI policy to block accidental divergent overlays. Proposed OPA rule (pseudo):
```
package redwood.k8s
deny[msg] {
  input.kind == "DaemonSet"
  input.metadata.labels["env"] == "prod"
  input.spec.template.spec.nodeSelector.accelerator != data.expected_gpu
  msg = "prod gpu SKU must match expected_gpu"
}
```

oncall: i'm okay with a targeted reconcile for staging to bring it back in sync, but hold prod. please open a PR to revert the staging-only change or make it explicit in the overlay name.

ashley: opened PR #872 to scope the change to staging overlay and added a note. will also remove the nodeSelector tweak from prod overlay.

maria: to perform a safe remediation: `gitopsctl sync --app=infra-inference-staging --resource=daemonset/gpu-sidecar --dry-run` then `--approve` after review. i'll run the dry-run and post results.

jonas: note on cost: we've been getting billed for reserved GPUs in staging because the autoscaler couldn't drain nodes with mismatched sidecars. if we don't fix this soon we risk another month of wasted reserved capacity. can finance tag this as chargeback risk? :warning:

devops: created an issue to add a pre-apply kustomize/OPA check in the infra CI (refs #540). also adding a gitops webhook to reject overlay merges that touch prod overlays without a changelog entry.

maria: dry-run shows only staging will change (no prod diff). ready to approve once ashley confirms PR. thanks all :thumbsup:

oncall: approved. staging reconcile starting in 5. monitoring for node eviction errors. if anything spikes, ping me with @oncall.
